```{r}

rm(list = objects())
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(data.table)
library(openxlsx)

DataDir<-""
OutDir<-""

# load complte m-path data, cleaned
load(paste0(DataDir, "data.RData"))


table(df$Studienummer)
table(df$Completed, df$Studienummer) # all participants, also the excluded ones 
# select Qs that are filled out
df<-df[!is.na(df$start),]

# only pariticpants that completed the study
df<-df[df$Completed==1,]


# select the questionnaires
ev_meet<-df[df$questionnaire=="Evalatie app"| df$questionnaire=="Evaluatie app",] # evaluatie na meetperiode
ev_exp<-df[df$questionnaire=="Evaluatie Booster ",]   # evaluatie einde 




```
# clean data 
```{r}
# remove the second UQ of B13
table(ev_meet$Studienummer) # B13 has two
ev_meet <- ev_meet[, colSums(!is.na(ev_meet)) > 0]
ev_meet <- ev_meet[!(ev_meet$Studienummer== "B13" & ev_meet$start_date> "2025-04-16"),]

# remove the UQ B23 before end of intervention
table(ev_exp$Studienummer) # only B23 has 3
ev_exp <- ev_exp[, colSums(!is.na(ev_exp)) > 0]
ev_exp <- ev_exp[!(ev_exp$Studienummer== "B23" & ev_exp$start_date<ev_exp$T3_Evaluatiegesprek_date),]

```

# select coluns of interest
```{r}
exp_cols <- c(
  "Studienummer",  "Completed",
 # "scheduled", "sent", "start", "stop", "scheduled_orig",
  "usability_e", "behulpzaam_e", "leuk_e", "duidelijk_e", "mooi_e",
  "geheel_e", "toekomst_e", "toekomst_ja_e", "toekomst_nee_e", "NPS_e",
  "gebruik_e", "motivatie_e", "motivatie_spel_e", "motivatie_track_e",
  "motivatie_punten_e", "motivatie_teksten_e", "motivatie_dagboek_e",
  "motivatie_voortgang_e", "motivatie_rapport_e", "motivatie_droom_e",
  "motivatie_gesprekken_e", "gesprekken_waarde_e",
  "effect_e_string", "fse_e",
  "fse_personalisatie_e", "fse_checkups_e", "fse_terugblik_e",
  "fse_dagboek_e", "fse_rapport_e", "fse_voortgang_e",
  "fse_doelinapp_e", "fse_doelgehaald_e",
  "beste_e", "minste_e", "feedback_e"
)

meet_cols <- c(
  "Studienummer", "Completed",
#  "scheduled", "sent", "start", "stop", "scheduled_orig",
  "usability_m", "behulpzaam_m", "leuk_m", "duidelijk_m", "mooi_m",
  "geheel_m", "toekomst_m", "toekomst_ja_m", "toekomst_nee_m", "NPS_m",
  "gebruik_m", "motivatie_m", "motivatie_spel_m", "motivatie_track_m",
  "motivatie_punten_m", "motivatie_teksten_meet", "motivatie_dagboek_m",
  "motivatie_awards_m", "motivatie_gesprekken_m", "gesprekken_waarde_m",
  "effect_m_string", "fse_m",
  "fse_personalisatie_m", "fse_checkups_m", "fse_terugblik_m",
  "fse_dagboek_m",
  "beste_m", "minste_m", "feedback_m"
)


uq_e<-ev_exp[,exp_cols]
uq_m<-ev_meet[,meet_cols]

```

```{r}
exp_summary <- uq_e %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      list(
        mean   = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd     = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        Q1     = ~quantile(.x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        Q3     = ~quantile(.x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = c("variable", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(.+)_(mean|sd|median|Q1|Q3)$"
  )

exp_summary<-exp_summary %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 1)))


mt_summary <- uq_m %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      list(
        mean   = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd     = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        Q1     = ~quantile(.x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        Q3     = ~quantile(.x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = c("variable", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(.+)_(mean|sd|median|Q1|Q3)$"
  )

mt_summary<-mt_summary %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 1)))
```

# save the output 
```{r}

wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(wb, "UQ_meet_summary")
writeData(wb, sheet = "UQ_meet_summary", mt_summary)


addWorksheet(wb, "UQ_meet_part")
writeData(wb, sheet = "UQ_meet_part", uq_m)


addWorksheet(wb, "UQ_exp_summary")
writeData(wb, sheet = "UQ_exp_summary", exp_summary)


addWorksheet(wb, "UQ_exp_part")
writeData(wb, sheet = "UQ_exp_part", uq_e)


saveWorkbook(wb, paste0(OutDir,"2026-04-10_UQ_Meet_Exp.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE )


```
